label: Total fertility rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = two collectors, priority-merged under Eurostat (v28.1): Eurostat demo_find TOTFERRT, the national official total fertility rates as collected by Eurostat (questionnaire collector), 47 country codes on the main slice (46 printing values, Bosnia none) plus the two French series — 46 valued entities, 1960-2024, per-observation status flags (b/e/p) transported as-reported; and UN DYB Table 4's PRINTED total fertility rate (field: tfr), editions 2011-2024 (2016 FILEPASS-encrypted, deliberately absent), 222 resolved entities over 2007-2024, sex=None by construction, per-point footnote refs and reference ranges transported as-reported, explicit "..." gaps kept as gap points. Overlap arbitration: Eurostat wins every shared entity-year (discarded DYB values logged in provenance.json); the 7 seam entities (Azerbaijan, Romania, Bulgaria, Georgia, Latvia, Moldova, Montenegro) are collector-vs-collector definitional seams, displayed never reconciled. Witness tier = UN WPP estimates via the World Bank's SP.DYN.TFRT.IN (modeled, ~200 countries, 1960-2024, the WDI print precision as carried: FRA 2022 = 1.78, RUS 1990 = 1.892). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: displayed beside each other, never blended.

notes:
THE EIGHTH INDICATOR, THE CORPUS'S #1 (111 citations, 16/16 books — fertility is the only metric Todd uses in every book: the 19th-century European transition of L'invention de l'Europe and L'enfance du monde, the Soviet natality collapse of La Chute finale, the world TFR decline of Après l'Empire, the onset dates of Où en sommes-nous ?, the 2015 Catholic-periphery comparison of Qui est Charlie ?). The unit is CHILDREN PER WOMAN — the corpus notes' "TFR decline", "threshold crossings" and "onset dates" are all statements about this quantity; the replacement threshold (~2.1) against which Todd reads every series is native to it. higher_is_better is REQUIRED by the schema but carries no normative claim here: the corpus's dominant signal is the fertility TRANSITION (the decline), so false is the least-misleading default — the board reads levels and drops, not a direction. THE SEX DIMENSION IS ABSENT BY CONSTRUCTION: TFR is already a synthetic measure over women's lifetimes; no split exists to report, and every point carries sex=None.
CANONICAL TIER: Eurostat first (three sources, one collector). The main slice (demo_find/TOTFERRT) serves 47 country codes, 46 of them printing values — Western Europe annually from 1960 (65 points each), the Eastern partnership partially (Russia 2006-2010, Belarus to 2018, Ukraine to 2019, Moldova to 2023 — the national offices stopped answering the questionnaire, the collector's honest freeze, exactly Russia's last DYB life table; Bosnia and Herzegovina prints NO point at all, the questionnaire never answered), the UK to 2018 (Brexit ended the series: pre-2019 British comparisons are canonical-only, post-2019 witness-only). The German series is 2000-2024 (DE wired; DE_TOT dropped at parse — verified live to print values identical to DE on every one of the 25 overlapping years). Kosovo (XK) prints 2016-2019 but resolves to no ISO3: it flows to the unresolved report, the SAME pending product decision as the World Bank's Kosovo — a decision, not a bug. THE FX/FR SEAM: France rides TWO series (FX metropolitan 1960-2012, FR whole-France 1998-2024); the merge keeps FX 1960-1997 + FR 1998-2024 and arbitrates the 15 overlap years to FR (later vintage wins, each discarded FX value logged in provenance.json) — the definitional seam the collector itself printed (1998: 1.76 metro vs 1.78 total; 2000: 1.87 vs 1.89; 2010: 2.02 vs 2.03), displayed, never reconciled. The collector's per-observation flags ride as-reported: quality_code carries the printed letter (b = break in series, e = estimated, p = provisional — FR 2014 carries 'b', the French series' own methodological break), provisional=true where the flag contains p.
THE DYB DOOR (v28.1, the second collector): Table 4's printed TFR, editions 2011-2024 priority-ordered (later edition = later vintage = higher priority, the edition-loop precedent; 2016 FILEPASS-encrypted, deliberately absent, verified live), every value sex=None (a synthetic measure over women's lifetimes has no split to report — the TOTFERRT discipline), per-point footnote refs (Japan's values carry their note; Korea's carry '102' on the 2024 edition) and reference ranges as-reported, explicit "..." gaps kept as gap points (the collector computes rates only for C/"|"-grade registration — the same honest degradation as Table 15). Where both collectors print, Eurostat wins (priority, provenance-logged): the 564-key overlap is 505/564 within 0.05 (rounding-level agreement), with 7 entities carrying real collector-vs-collector seams (Azerbaijan the widest at 0.44 — the DYB's ~2.3 against Eurostat's ~1.9, both as-reported by their own questionnaire chains; then Romania, Bulgaria, Georgia, Latvia, Moldova, Montenegro) — two collectors' definitional seams, displayed, never reconciled. What the door ADDS: the whole non-European civil-registration world (222 resolved entities, 2007-2024 — Japan, Korea, the US, Israel, New Zealand, Latin America, Asia, Africa's registration countries), the UK's post-Brexit 2019-2023 (the canonical series resumed — pre-v28.1 the UK was witness-only there), and Eurostat's own single hole-years (Belarus 2009, Ukraine 2013, Moldova 2013/2016, Georgia 2011/2013/2021). China prints NO TFR row at all in any wired edition (the collector's own hole — the witness carries China, as it always has).
WITNESS TIER: one door, the minimal honest choice (the v13 discipline): WDI's WPP redistribution, worldwide — the face the canonical tier's honest partiality cannot serve (Todd's Muslim-world and Central-Asia comparisons of Après l'Empire live HERE, on the modeled layer, next to a collector that never asked those countries). Where the tiers agree (EU, post-2000), they agree because WPP anchors on the national series — the root field says so (un_wpp beside eurostat_demo: two independent roots, the genealogy display's exact case); where they diverge (Russia after 2010 — collector frozen, witness modeled on), the divergence IS the story the board displays.
HONEST SCOPE LIMITS: no 19th-century history on the canonical tier (Eurostat starts 1960 — Todd's 1870-1930 European transition onset dates are BOOK data, territory for the curated tier or the HFD decision); no USSR entity (dissolved before the wire); the witness inherits WPP's revisions silently (no vintage pinning on that door). UNWIRED DOORS, recorded for the next decisions: GHO 'tfr' (a third un_wpp door — the "illusion of independent verification" warning applies, one witness door suffices), OWID 'children-per-woman' (pure WPP 1950-2023, 254 entities — same root again) and 'total-fertility-rate' (WPP + pre-1950 depth for a handful of countries, Sweden from 1891 — would need its own composite root), DYB Table 9 (the collector's CBR face, a different unit — the wired crude_birth_rate companion), DYB Table 10 (general + age-specific fertility rates, latest-available-year cross-sections, no TFR column — verified on the 2024 file), and the Human Fertility Database (France from 1817, the collector with the historical depth Todd's onset dates need — the HMD-class pending decision recorded in sources.yaml).
